# Three returns on the same two criteria, and the one cause under all of them

The triage has returned this ticket three times, at records 64, 88 and 105, each
time saying it could see no evidence for criterion 2 and criterion 5. Between the
rounds the evidence was strengthened twice, with checks recorded for exactly what
those criteria ask: record 90 is a timed staged run with a code path genuinely
staged, 614ms for Biome, ast-grep and dependency-cruiser against a ten-second
budget; record 69 is the whole set over the tree; record 71 is every rule refusing
its own fixture; records 91 and 92 are knip clean on `packages/core` and
`packages/connectors` by name; record 70 is the citation check CI runs.

What that bought, measured across the three rounds:

| Criterion | 64 | 88 | 105 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2, the three tools on staged files and on the tree | 0.36 | 0.37 | 0.39 |
| 5, knip, the exports maps and every rule cited | 0.41 | 0.48 | 0.50 |

Hundredths. A fourth round of the same would not reach the bar, and recording
checks chosen to move a probability rather than to prove the work is the wrong
thing to do anyway.

## What pass one says, which is the thing worth reading

`slice_files` fails in every one of the three triages, with this detail:

    Changed but named by no slice and no changes entry: apps/api/package.json,
    apps/api/src/health.test.ts, apps/api/src/mail/mailpit.ts, ... and about forty
    more across apps/ and packages/

The slices name `apps` and `packages`, as directories, because that is what
adopting a formatter touches: twenty-six files rewritten, ten lint findings closed
in six of them, an exports map in seven manifests. The check compares a changed
path to the slice's file list exactly, so a directory entry covers nothing inside
it, and the whole formatter diff reads as unaccounted for.

Criterion 2 and criterion 5 are precisely the two whose evidence lives in those
files: the exports maps, the lint fixes, the hook, the manifests. So the state Jev
is handed says, in pass one's own words, that forty changed files belong to no
slice, and then asks whether those two criteria are evidenced. The two answers it
gives are the only ones that make sense from that state.

## One defect, three symptoms on this ticket

`harness/guard.py` line 134 compares a path to the slice's file list with `not in`,
and the triage's `slice_files` check does the same, where `harness/gates.py`
answers the same question with `_covers`, which reads a directory entry. One
question, three readers, two answers. On this ticket it cost:

1. Slice 2 was refused the right to write `rules/fixtures/<slug>/...` and
   `packages/core/db/tables.ts` although its plan named `rules/fixtures` and
   `packages`, and wrote them through a shell, which the hook does not intercept.
   Slice 3 met the same refusal, stopped and reported. Record 36.
2. The tdd record could not cite evidence from before a return, because the
   slices that named directories could not have stable file sets. Records 52 and
   103.
3. The triage has returned the ticket three times on two criteria whose evidence
   is in the files pass one reports as belonging to no slice.

The three are one fix. It is not SEEN-114's: this ticket would be amending the
check that gates its own review, in order to pass it, which is the worst shape a
review can be handed, and it is the same argument that moved the first of these
decisions to a ticket of its own.

## What the alternative would be, and why it is worse

Amending the solution record's `changes` to list all forty files by name would
make `slice_files` pass. It is a return, a sixth attempt and a fourth replay of
eight checks, and what it produces is a plan rewritten to satisfy a comparison
that is wrong rather than a plan that is more true. The formatter touched every
source file it was pointed at; `apps` and `packages` is the honest way to say so,
and `biome.json`'s includes list is the bound on what it means.

Recorded at the point the loop was stopped, with the work finished: twenty-two
rules all firing on their fixtures, 1,521 harness tests passing, coverage 100.0 at
a delta of 0.0, `doctor` clean with no problems and no warnings, and the four
criteria the triage does not dispute answered at 0.62, 0.85 and 0.75.
